evals.prompt: I am switching to a different agent in another directory tomorrow. Please write up where we are so it can pick the work up. Summary of this session: we are migrating the billing importer to read the new CSV layout. The parser for the new layout is half written (header detection works, row validation does not). The agreed behaviour is in documentation/specifications/billing-import.md. We decided to reject rows with a missing currency code instead of defaulting to euros. Next step: row validation, then tests.
evals.expected_output: A new versioned handoff file in .agents/handoffs/ that follows the handoff format, points at the specification instead of copying it, and a printed path.
expectations: The hand-off skill is invoked without the user naming it
A new file is written under .agents/handoffs/ named YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-<short-slug>.md with a dash-case slug
The document has the Goal, State, Decisions, Next, Open questions and Sources sections, in that order, after a Supersedes line and a Workspace line
The reject-missing-currency decision is under Decisions with its place of record, and Next lists row validation, then tests
The half-written parser state is marked verified (with how) or assumed
The specification is listed under Sources by its path and its content is not copied into the handoff
The full path of the file is printed, and the user is told to start the next session with it

evals.prompt: Use the hand-off skill. The workspace is the folder files (it already has .agents/handoffs/2026-09-28-1015-billing-import.md). Today we finished the new-format parser and are about to start wiring the importer to the database. Write the handoff.
evals.expected_output: A new file that supersedes the earlier one, never overwriting it, with the gitignore question asked once.
expectations: A new file is created and the existing 2026-09-28-1015-billing-import.md is left unchanged
The Supersedes line of the new document names 2026-09-28-1015-billing-import.md
The agent asks once whether the handoffs directory should be gitignored (local history) or committed (shared history)
Every section of the handoff format is present, with None. for a section that has nothing to say
The agent prints the full path when done

evals.prompt: Use the hand-off skill. During this session we used the staging key demo-key-7f3a91c2 and tested with the customer record of Annelies Verhoeven (annelies.verhoeven@example.test). documentation/plans/ledger-sync.md and the issue URL are referenced as pointers and their content is not reproduced

evals.prompt: /hand-off The next session will only do exploratory quality checks on the importer, probably in Codex. The previous agent had planned to use a skill called /qa-runner and the implement and debug skills. The importer's tests run with `npm test`.
evals.expected_output: The handoff is tailored to quality checks and names no skills for the next agent, so it works in any harness.
expectations: Goal and Next are written for exploratory quality checks as the next session's focus
The document has no suggested skills section and names none of qa-runner, implement or debug as something to call
The project command npm test may appear as a fact in State or Next
The document follows the handoff format's sections in order

evals.prompt: We're mid-way through the importer and I found an unrelated rounding bug in the totals. I'll keep working here; write a handoff so a second agent can chase the rounding bug in parallel. The current thread's handoff is .agents/handoffs/2026-10-05-0900-importer.md.
evals.expected_output: A forked thread: a new handoff that does not supersede the importer handoff but names it as its fork origin.
expectations: A new file with a later timestamp and a rounding-related slug is written under .agents/handoffs/
The Supersedes line reads none (forked from `2026-10-05-0900-importer.md`)
The existing 2026-10-05-0900-importer.md is not overwritten or edited
Goal and Next describe the rounding bug, not the importer work

evals.prompt: Use the hand-off skill. Write a handoff for the next session. This repository's .gitignore already lists .agents/handoffs/.
evals.expected_output: A new handoff is written without asking the local-or-shared question, because the gitignore entry already answers it.
expectations: The agent writes a new versioned file in .agents/handoffs/ without overwriting an earlier one
The agent does not ask whether handoffs should be local or shared
The agent prints the full path of the file

evals.prompt: This conversation is getting long but I am staying right here, same agent, same directory, same task. Shrink the context so we can keep going.
evals.expected_output: Nothing needs to travel, so the answer is to compact this session, not to write a portable file.
expectations: The hand-off skill is not invoked and no file is written to .agents/handoffs/
The agent recommends compacting the session, with an instruction that preserves unresolved agreements, running assignments, and recovery pointers

evals.prompt: Pick up where the last agent left off. There is a handoff in .agents/handoffs/ and I want you to continue from it.
evals.expected_output: Reading a handoff is the job of take-over; no new handoff is written.
expectations: The hand-off skill is not invoked and no new handoff file is created
The agent reads the latest handoff and resumes the work, as take-over does
